title: Descent

story.briefing: The shaft descends in halves. A reading that is even drops to half its value; an odd one steps down by one. Count the drops until it reaches the floor.
story.success: Descent counted. The shaft opens onto the lower network.

description: Starting from an integer n, repeatedly apply one rule: if the value is even, halve it; if it is odd, subtract 1. Return how many steps it takes to reach 1. If n is already 1, the answer is 0.
hints: A recursive solution needs two things: a case that stops, and a case that makes the problem smaller. Identify both before writing anything.
Every step must strictly reduce the value, or the recursion never ends. Check that both rules do that — including the odd rule.
If n is 1, return 0. Otherwise return 1 plus the result of calling yourself with n halved when even, or n minus 1 when odd.
